svg.title: One heartbeat, four hops. PULSE SENSOR: reads the pulse as an analog signal. ARDUINO: turns it into BPM and IBI. WI-FI: carries both values into Unity. UNITY SHADER: breathing and pulsing effects, in real time. PHONE: a swiped card spawns an object in VR. TEAM OF 4 · MIT REALITY HACK 2026.
